note.zh: 在修正运行环境配置后，以明确的第 2 次子尝试通过 AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 的精确选择器 gemini-3.7-flash（High）使用仓库标准中文提示词生成，源码未经人工修改，耗时 2 分 3 秒。原生系统提示正常启用，工作区未注入 AGENTS.md、额外上下文文件、外部 Skill、插件或 MCP，外部 URL 与 Web Search 动作被阻断；由于 AntiGravity 没有可验证的内置 Skill 与上下文发现总开关，隔离状态为 partial。CLI 未回报运行时模型 ID，归因依据为已选择的精确目录项。交付修复仅将原始 HTML 通过 CDN 请求的 Three.js 0.128.0 精确内联，未修改游戏逻辑；原始归档与远端对象已保留，并通过审计 repair-artifact 路径发布。此前受基础设施配置影响的父尝试不计作模型结果。
note.en: Generated from the repository's canonical Chinese prompt after the runtime configuration was corrected, as an explicit second child attempt using AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 with the exact gemini-3.7-flash selector (High), with unmodified source, in 2 minutes 3 seconds. The native system prompt remained enabled, no AGENTS.md, extra context files, external skills, plugins, or MCP were injected, and outbound URL and Web Search actions were blocked. Because AntiGravity has no verifiable master switch for bundled skills or context discovery, isolation is recorded as partial. The CLI did not report a runtime model ID; attribution is based on the exact selected catalog entry. The delivery-only repair precisely inlines Three.js 0.128.0, which the original HTML requested from a runtime CDN, without changing game logic; the original archive and remote object are preserved, and the repair was published through the audited repair-artifact path. The earlier parent attempt affected by infrastructure configuration is excluded from the model result.

note.zh: 在修正运行环境配置后，以明确的第 2 次子尝试通过 AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 的精确选择器 gemini-3.7-flash（High）使用仓库标准中文提示词生成，源码未经人工修改，耗时 4 分 58 秒。Agent 实际完成生产构建并交付浏览器可运行的 dist/index.html；真实浏览器验收可进入 5v5 场景并渲染 HUD、雷达、武器与地图。运行隔离为 partial，外部 URL 与 Web Search 动作被阻断。产物额外引入了题目允许列表之外的 lucide-react，按原样保留并在此披露。此前受基础设施配置影响的父尝试不计作模型结果。
note.en: Generated from the repository's canonical Chinese prompt after the runtime configuration was corrected, as an explicit second child attempt using AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 with the exact gemini-3.7-flash selector (High), with unmodified source, in 4 minutes 58 seconds. The Agent completed a production build and delivered a browser-ready dist/index.html; a real-browser acceptance check entered the 5v5 scene and rendered the HUD, radar, weapon, and map. Isolation is partial, and outbound URL and Web Search actions were blocked. The artifact additionally imports lucide-react outside the case's allowed dependency list; it is retained unchanged and disclosed here. The earlier parent attempt affected by infrastructure configuration is excluded from the model result.

note.en: A vector illustration generated in one shot by Gemini 3.7 Flash (High effort) in AntiGravity as a standalone SVG, unmodified source. Features a lively pelican riding a bicycle with multi-layer sunset gradient sky, reflective waves, and coastal scenery.

note.en: An interactive 3D skeleton mechanical watch generated in one shot by Gemini 3.7 Flash (High effort) in AntiGravity as a self-contained single HTML file, unmodified source. Features a fully visible complex movement (barrel, gear train, balance wheel with hairspring, escapement, bridges, and ruby bearings), multiple luxury metal materials, luminous markers, exploded view, and interactive movement component info panels.
